meta.title: ShitShpejt — Deals don't wait
meta.description: Fixed-price deals that last only 48 hours. No auctions, no haggling. Phones, computers, gaming and more in Albania.

nav.fine: Every deal has a fixed price and lasts 48 hours. ShitShpejt is not part of the payment: meet the seller and check the item.

home.heroBody: Every item here has a fixed price and stays up for only 48 hours. No auctions, no haggling. First come, first served.

one.title: Photograph it
one.body: Real photos in natural light. No pictures from the internet.

two.title: Set a fixed price
two.body: No auctions, no haggling. The price can only go down during the deal.

three.title: Sold within 48 hours
three.body: When time is up, the deal is removed automatically. No endless renewals.

sell.lead: Publishing is free. Once published, the deal lasts exactly 48 hours.
sell.liveEditNotice: This deal is live. Edits don't restart the clock. The price can only go down; important changes may go back to review.
sell.photosHint: Take a photo or choose from your gallery
sell.photosRule: Up to {max} photos, real photos of the item only. The first one is the cover.
sell.title: What are you selling?
sell.priceHint: One price, no haggling. Buyers see it exactly as you write it.
sell.priceLiveHint: During the deal the price can only go down.
sell.locationHint: Approximate area only. Don't write your home address.
sell.referenceHint: If you know the current price of the item new, add it with its source. We show it as the seller's statement, with no discount percentage.
sell.contactHint: Your number only appears as a WhatsApp button on your live deals, and only if you consent.
sell.contactConsent: I agree that buyers may contact me on WhatsApp about my live deals.
sell.rules: No auctions, no offers, no automatic renewals. The deal is removed automatically after 48 hours.

dashboard.title: My dashboard
dashboard.statsNote: Views and contact clicks are traffic, not sales. A view counts once per visitor per day.
dashboard.emptyBody: Publish your first deal. It takes a minute if your photos are ready.
dashboard.confirmSold: Mark as sold? It will be removed from live deals.
dashboard.sentToReview: Sent for review. The 48-hour clock starts when it's approved.
dashboard.nowLive: Your deal is live! The 48-hour clock has started.
dashboard.publishReviewHint: First listings are reviewed by our team. The 48-hour clock starts only once approved.
dashboard.publishLiveHint: When you press “Publish”, the deal goes live immediately and lasts 48 hours.
dashboard.pendingHint: In review. The 48-hour clock starts when it's approved.
dashboard.pendingClockRuns: Your changes are in review. The original clock keeps running and is not extended.
dashboard.expiredHint: The deal expired. It doesn't renew automatically: if the item is still available, create a new listing.
dashboard.noContactWarning: Buyers can't contact you: you haven't added a WhatsApp number or consent.
dashboard.editSentToReview: Changes saved and sent for review. The clock does not restart.

promotions.title: Promotion
promotions.noExtension: A promotion moves the deal up, but never extends its 48-hour window.
promotions.paymentsSoon: Online payments aren't active yet. Promotions only activate after a confirmed payment.

account.title: Account
account.contactHint: Your number is never shown as text. Buyers only see the WhatsApp button on live deals.
account.contactConsent: I agree that buyers may contact me on WhatsApp about my live deals.
account.deleteBody: Live deals are removed, drafts are deleted and personal data is anonymised. This cannot be undone.

admin.trafficNote: Contact clicks are traffic, not confirmed transactions.
admin.confirmRemove: Remove this listing? This is recorded in the audit log.
admin.paymentsOff: No payment provider is connected. Promotions can only be activated by an admin grant, recorded in the audit log.

admin.workerNeverRan: The worker hasn't reported yet. Check that the “worker” service is running.
admin.errorsHint: Application errors are written to container logs (JSON). Connect Sentry/GlitchTip for alerts.
